question: Can the sign of a span skill's value reverse when the same kind of question would rank that source differently under single versus adjacent-turn writes? Forecast plausible future query embeddings from evidence-to-question displacements in other training histories. Deploy only the current source and the raw-return actor's existing predecision state. No question, answer, observed write or later source from the target is a decision input.
data: Use the registered 60 matched comparisons/452 question-action rows from the 12 early and 12 donor windows, including all 179 unique questions and seven surviving rule-2 labels. Read the corrected physical endpoints and same-skill vetoes. Bind each occupied contrast to its actual source, pivot and background. At each target hold out its entire history before selecting donor questions or rewards. Donor questions without annotated evidence in the acted-on span stay in coverage; they have no evidence-to-query displacement and cast no forecast vote.
geometry: Use the registered anonymized Qwen turn vectors. For both source-rule variants construct the actual dated groups with the 96-word split, remove the common date prefix, anonymize both speakers and encode each retained item on physical GPU 3 at duty .30, batch <=2 and >=2 GiB headroom. Only current-span source groups compete in this deployment proxy; old memories and generated summary items are not simulated. Each donor evidence turn maps to its nearest target turn. Translate the normalized donor question vector by target-minus-donor evidence centroid and unit normalize. For each source rule compute each mapped evidence turn's best reciprocal rank in the top five then average across evidence turns. Define the advantage as paired minus single retrieval utility.
actor: Freeze root and suffix separately for 128 local sources and 99 full-prefix endpoints prior to evaluation. For each donor row use its true donor query to compute donor retrieval advantage D. On a target predict transported advantage T using its mapped turns. Cases with nonzero verified credit c are admissible for the main actor only when c*D>0. Contribution is |c|*tanh(|D|/.2)*tanh(T/.2), allowing sign reversal. Within each external history softmax mean nearest-evidence cosine/.08 over its admissible cases; average the history votes over all external histories (histories without cases vote zero). Add the result divided by .05, clipped to [-2,2], to the frozen repaired raw-return logit. Raw-mechanism control substitutes signed raw F1 differences for c, keeping all admissible nonzero raw cases. Direct-query control omits the embedding translation; evidence-only control uses the mapped evidence centroid; flipped-credit control rotates the nonzero labels in sorted (window,bits,index) order within each held-history fold and stage before the admissibility check. Include the prior passage actor, original raw-return anchor, native and terminal. No benchmark result sets temperatures, amplification, masks or query geometry.
diagnostics: Before using endpoint F1 verify the classifier's actual retained cases, sign-reversing contributions across targets, and coverage by history. Compare with the oracle that knows each window's measured cell means, both unconstrained and restricted to +/-2 raw log odds. Enumerate eight probability corners for a full two-step trajectory and two for a randomized focal pair or prefix; never optimize separately for each question. Report actual actor draws, costs, propensity changes, clustered uncertainty, matched rates and strict prospective coverage. A focus-window oracle is not a bound on the unmeasured full sequential policy. Require +.02 over native and terminal on the complete 40-window later cohort, positive joint HT over both, gains over raw, rotated, direct-query, evidence-only, raw-mechanism and matched-rate, >=4 winning histories over matched, and positive strict and exact replication over native/raw. Complete the 99-endpoint long-prefix diagnostic. Formal development and independent LoCoMo/LongMemEval-S tests stay gated.
inspiration: Gao et al. ACL 2023 ground a hypothetical dense representation in actual corpus retrieval. This source-to-potential-query vector translation and paired action forecast is a new hypothesis, not an implementation of HyDE. https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.99/
